mend fences: After their big argument last week, Amy called Kate to apologize and try to mend fences.
上週大吵一架後，艾咪打電話給凱特道歉，試著修復關係。
mend one's ways: After being caught cheating on the test, Mark promised his teacher that he would mend his ways.
考試作弊被抓到後，馬克向老師保證他會改過自新。
mend a broken heart: People say that only time can mend a broken heart, but good friends can also help a lot.
人們說只有時間能療癒情傷，但好朋友也能幫上很大的忙。
on the mend: Grandma had a bad cold last week, but the doctor says she is on the mend now.
奶奶上週得了重感冒，不過醫生說她現在正在康復中。
mend clothes: My grandmother taught me how to mend clothes, so I can fix the holes in my socks myself.
我奶奶教我怎麼縫補衣服，所以我能自己補襪子上的破洞。
merge two companies: The bank plans to merge two companies into one large business to save money and serve more customers.
那家銀行計畫合併兩家公司成為一家大企業，以節省成本並服務更多客戶。
merge into traffic: When you drive onto the highway, you must speed up and merge into traffic carefully.
開上高速公路時，你必須加速並小心地併入車流。
merge into one: The two small rivers merge into one just before they reach the sea.
這兩條小河在即將入海前合而為一。
merge files: Before sending the report to the teacher, I need to merge files from all four group members.
把報告寄給老師之前，我需要合併四位組員的檔案。
mess up the plan: We wanted to have a picnic on Sunday, but a sudden storm could mess up the plan.
我們本想在星期天野餐，但突如其來的暴風雨可能會搞砸計畫。
mess with someone: Don't mess with Eric; he is the captain of the judo team and he hates being teased.
別惹艾瑞克，他是柔道隊隊長，而且很討厭被捉弄。
mess around: Don't mess around in class; listen to the teacher, or you will fail the exam.
上課別鬼混，好好聽老師講，不然你考試會不及格。
make a mess of: I tried to cut my own hair to save money, but I made a mess of it.
我為了省錢試著自己剪頭髮，結果弄得一團糟。
mess with one's head: The movie's strange ending really messed with my head, and I couldn't sleep that night.
這部電影奇怪的結局真的擾亂了我的思緒，害我那晚睡不著。
milk the system: The man was arrested because he tried to milk the system by collecting welfare money while working full-time.
那名男子被捕，因為他一邊做全職工作一邊領社會救濟金，企圖鑽制度漏洞牟利。
milk the situation: After hurting his foot slightly, my brother milked the situation and made everyone bring him snacks all weekend.
我弟弟的腳受了點小傷後，就從情況中撈好處，整個週末都要大家拿零食給他。
milk a cow: On our school trip to the farm, each of us got a chance to milk a cow by hand.
在學校的農場校外教學中，我們每個人都有機會親手擠牛奶。
milk the applause: The singer bowed again and again, milking the applause long after the song had ended.
歌手一再鞠躬，在歌曲結束許久後仍刻意延長掌聲。
mine data: Online stores mine data from millions of shopping records to discover hidden patterns in what customers buy.
網路商店從數百萬筆購物紀錄中挖掘數據，找出顧客購買行為中隱藏的模式。
mine coal: In the past, many men in this small town went deep underground every day to mine coal.
過去，這個小鎮的許多男人每天都深入地底採煤。
a mine of information: My grandfather is a mine of information about the history of our town, so I interviewed him for my project.
我祖父是我們鎮上歷史的資訊寶庫，所以我為了專題去訪問他。
mine for gold: In the 1800s, thousands of people traveled to California to mine for gold and get rich.
在十九世紀，數千人前往加州淘金，想要致富。
minimize risk: To minimize risk, the climbers checked the weather report and their ropes before starting up the mountain.
為了把風險降到最低，登山客在出發上山前先查看天氣預報並檢查繩索。
minimize the damage: When the typhoon was coming, we put tape on the windows to minimize the damage to our house.
颱風要來時，我們在窗戶貼上膠帶，以減少房子的損害。
minimize costs: The restaurant buys vegetables directly from local farmers to minimize costs and keep prices low.
這家餐廳直接向當地農民買蔬菜，以降低成本並維持低價。
minimize the window: When his mom walked into the room, Ben quickly minimized the window so she couldn't see his game.
媽媽走進房間時，班很快地縮小視窗，讓她看不到他在玩的遊戲。
mirror the trend: The drop in sales at our small store simply mirrors the trend seen across the country as more people shop online.
我們小店的業績下滑，正反映出全國可見的趨勢，因為越來越多人在網路上購物。
mirror one's feelings: The gray, rainy weather seemed to mirror her feelings after she failed the important exam.
灰暗多雨的天氣似乎反映了她重要考試落榜後的心情。
mirror each other: The twin sisters often mirror each other, laughing at the same jokes and making the same faces.
這對雙胞胎姊妹常常互相映照，對同樣的笑話發笑，做出同樣的表情。
mirror image: The two buildings were designed as a mirror image of each other, one on each side of the river.
這兩棟建築被設計成彼此的鏡像，分別位於河的兩岸。
